event_summary: ヴィヴァルディは晩年ウィーンで貧困のうちに客死し、共同墓地に無名のまま葬られた。その後約200年間、彼の名前と音楽はほぼ完全に忘れ去られていたが、20世紀に楽譜が再発見されて「四季」が復活し、今日ではバロック音楽を代表する作曲家として世界的に知られている。
hook_copy: 貧しく[R]共同墓地に無名で埋葬[/R]、[G]200年後に世界的名曲[/G]へ
portrait_prompt: Illustrated cinematic portrait of the Italian Baroque composer Antonio Vivaldi, based on the traditional 18th-century oil portrait attributed to him held at the Museo Internazionale e Biblioteca della Musica di Bologna, and consistent with the 1723 Ghezzi caricature and La Cave engraving. Bust-to-shoulder composition, three-quarter view. He wears a long curled allonge wig, and the wig itself has a distinct warm reddish-copper tint throughout (not plain grey or white) — clearly visible auburn-red coloring in the curls, immediately evoking his famous nickname "Il Prete Rosso" (the Red Priest) for his red hair. He has a soft, rounded face with a fairly high forehead, gentle deep-set dark eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth with a slightly receding chin. His complexion is pale with a faint warm flush on the cheeks. He is dressed as a Catholic priest in a plain, unadorned black cassock with a modest white clerical collar/band at the throat — no gold trim, lace, or decorative embroidery, keeping the attire humble and true to the historical portrait. Painterly, illustrated cinematic rendering, not photorealistic, soft directional light modeling the face. Background is a plain, muted solid tone (dark neutral brown or grey) with no vignette. The illustration must fill the entire frame edge-to-edge with no border, no empty margin, and no darkened edges, so it can be cropped tightly into an oval frame. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the image.

middle_slides.text: 18世紀ヴェネツィアで絶大な人気を誇った作曲家アントニオ・ヴィヴァルディは、孤児院で暮らす少女たちに音楽を教える神父でもあった。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly illustration, not photorealistic, of 18th-century Venice. Inside a warm sunlit hall of an orphanage (ospedale), a priest-composer resembling Antonio Vivaldi — pale rounded face, gentle dark eyes, a wig with a clearly visible warm auburn-red tint throughout the curls (not grey or white), evoking his nickname "the Red Priest", dressed in a plain black cassock with white clerical collar — stands facing forward, gently teaching a small group of young orphan girls in modest grey dresses who hold violins and sheet music. He gestures warmly toward the girls while facing the viewers general direction, violin resting in his other hand. Sunlight streams through tall arched windows overlooking a Venetian canal in the background. Warm golden color palette, soft brushwork, no text anywhere.

middle_slides.text: 後年、パトロンだった皇帝カール6世の宮廷職を求めてウィーンへ移るが、頼みの皇帝は着任直後に病死し、彼は収入も名声も一気に失っていった。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly illustration, not photorealistic. In front of the grand baroque facade of the Habsburg imperial court in Vienna, a middle-aged composer resembling Antonio Vivaldi — pale rounded face, gentle dark eyes, natural reddish hair beneath a pale curled wig, wearing a plain black priest's cassock now looking worn and travel-weary — stands facing the palace entrance in three-quarter view, his posture slumped with disappointment, holding a rolled musical score at his side. The sky is overcast and autumnal, with bare trees and grey stone architecture conveying a sense of lost hope and fading fortune. No other identifiable historical figures shown. Muted cool color palette, soft brushwork, no text anywhere.

middle_slides.text: 1741年、ウィーンで客死。葬儀は簡素に済まされ、共同墓地に埋葬された彼の名は、以後200年近く音楽史から忘れ去られた。

A plain wooden coffin is being lowered into a simple communal grave by two anonymous gravediggers, with no mourners of importance present. A faint, ghostly, translucent painterly impression of the composer resembling Antonio Vivaldi — pale rounded face, gentle dark eyes, reddish hair beneath a pale curled wig, dressed in a black cassock — is seen from behind, face not visible, standing at a distance among bare wintry trees, as if his spirit is departing the scene, fully turned away with no twisting of the head. Desaturated, cold color palette, heavy brushwork, no text anywhere.

middle_slides.text: 20世紀になって埋もれていた楽譜が発見され「四季」が復活。現在では世界で最も演奏される名曲のひとつとして親しまれている。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly illustration, not photorealistic. A dusty archive table displays a bundle of yellowed, aged music manuscripts tied with faded ribbon, papers curling at the edges, alongside an old violin resting nearby, evoking a 20th-century rediscovery. Rising softly and translucently from the glowing pages, as if emerging from memory, is a semi-transparent painterly likeness of the composer resembling Antonio Vivaldi facing forward — pale rounded face, gentle dark eyes, natural reddish hair beneath a pale curled wig, dressed in a plain black cassock — his expression calm, symbolizing his musical revival. Warm golden light beams onto the manuscripts suggesting renewed fame. Rich, warm color palette, soft brushwork, no text anywhere.

fb_caption:
ヴェネツィアの孤児院で少女たちにヴァイオリンを教えていた一人の神父は、晩年ウィーンの共同墓地に無名のまま葬られた。その"赤毛の司祭"ことアントニオ・ヴィヴァルディの名前は、死後200年近く音楽史から消えたまま、20世紀になってようやく「四季」とともに世界的な名声を得た。🎻

「忙しい大人のためのクラシック音楽ノート」では、忙しい日々の合間に、
ほんの数分だけ立ち止まりたくなる、クラシック音楽の物語を発信しています。
指揮者マエストロ・ノートが案内する、作曲家たちの知られざる人生の
ドラマ——栄光の裏にあった挫折、常識をくつがえす意外な真実——を、
毎日少しずつお届けしています。

難しい知識は必要ありません。ただ、物語として楽しんでいただければ、
それだけで十分です。

くわしくはYouTubeの本編でご覧ください。https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=krkJJ2TI6LY
